tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search over the Slovak fishing portal: fishing waters ("revír"), rivers and lakes ("tok"), river basins ("povodie"), fish species, wildlife, guides, local SRZ organisations and competitions. Returns titles, URLs and short details. The query can be in any language of the site (Slovak, Czech

tools.name: get_water
tools.description: Details of one fishing water (revír), river/lake (tok) or river basin (povodie): code, water type, river, region and district, SRZ organisation, length, coordinates, key properties and page URL. Pass the numeric id from search_site/waters_near results, or the page url.

tools.name: waters_near
tools.description: Lists fishing waters (revíry) within a radius of a Slovak district town or of given coordinates, nearest first, with distance, water type, river, district and SRZ organisation. Give either city or both lat and lon.

tools.name: get_water_conditions
tools.description: Current weather at the water, a modelled fishing-activity score (0-100), estimated water temperature and the best time window of the day. Values come from a weather model and are an estimate, not a guarantee of catch.

tools.name: get_fish_species
tools.description: Looks up a fish species by its name in any language of the site or its Latin name and returns what the Slovak decree says about it: year-round protection, minimum size, closed season, water types, plus the page URL. Informative only; always check the rules of the specific water.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Businesses listed in the portal catalogue near a fishing water or place: accommodation, restaurants, fishing tackle shops, e-shops (by region), guides and boat rental, and fish sales. Returns name, type, distance, district, starting price, opening hours text, website and page URL; phone and e-mail a

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one listing from list_services (id): type, municipality and district, position, website, prices with units (e.g. per person per night), capacity (beds, extra beds, rooms), minimum stay, check-in and check-out, season and open months, room amenities and amenities for anglers, payment

tools.name: fishing_rules_today
tools.description: What the Slovak fishing act and decree say for a given day: whether all fishing is closed on trout, grayling and carp waters, the legal daily fishing hours, and which species are in their protection period. With water_id it also says which water types apply to that water. National rules only; the wa

tools.name: list_catches
tools.description: Catches recorded by anglers on the portal (species, length, weight, date, water, whether released, angler's public name, page URL), optionally for one water or river and one species, ordered by length, weight or date. Exact catch spots are never returned. Entries are supplied by anglers.

tools.name: get_bed_model
tools.description: Summary of the portal's 3D bed model of a reservoir, lake or river section: maximum and mean depth, water volume, surface area, water level, where the depth comes from (pre-flooding maps, literature, angling rules or an estimate), sources and notes. It is a model, not a survey: not for navigation or

tools.name: get_srz_organisation
tools.description: A local or town organisation of the Slovak Anglers' Union (MO/MsO SRZ) by name: registered address, website, portal page and the fishing waters it manages (with ids for get_water). Personal contacts of officials are not provided.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Articles from the portal blog (portal news, how-tos and tips, waters, fish and nature, readers' stories): title, date, category, short excerpt and URL, newest first, optionally filtered by text or category. Articles are written in Slovak (with translations where available); reader articles are writt

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: Upcoming angling competitions and events published on the portal (date, place, organiser, kind, page URL). Texts are supplied by the organisers.
